name: QuickBooks Payroll
summary: QuickBooks Payroll is sold as Workforce bundles. The cheapest listed bundle is $88 plus $6.50 per employee, shown as $44 for the first three months on a 50% promotion. It calculates, files and pays federal and state payroll taxes, offers same-day direct deposit, and gives employees pay stubs through QuickBooks Workforce.

facts.text: QuickBooks says it will calculate, file and pay federal and state payroll taxes, and guarantees 100% accurate tax calculations.
Employees can view and print their own pay stubs and W-2s online through QuickBooks Workforce.
The page advertises same-day direct deposit, and the Essentials bundle adds a 7:00 am cutoff for it.
Background checks cost extra, starting at $29.99 per report.
